svg.title: States of the island in the FerrionOS top bar
svg.desc: The island in seven states: at rest it is an empty capsule; a change of a workspace's layout, a notification, a volume change, a task with progress, a recording and a waiting agent each reshape it.

g.aria-label: One capsule in the middle of the top bar for what the system is doing now. It grows from its own middle and returns.
A workspace changed its layout, for 2 seconds
The screen is being recorded: says who, and a press stops it
An agent waits for an answer: asks
